mapper.insert:
select seqAiRoute.nextval from dual
INSERT INTO tblAiRoute ( AI_ROUTE_ID, USER_ID, AI_ROUTE_TITLE, AI_ROUTE_DAYS, AI_ROUTE_CREATED, AI_ROUTE_REGION, AI_ROUTE_STARTDATE, AI_ROUTE_ENDDATE, WEATHER_CONSIDERATION ) VALUES ( #{aiRouteId}, #{userId}, #{aiRouteTitle}, #{aiRouteDays}, SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', #{aiRouteRegion}, TO_DATE(#{aiRouteStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{aiRouteEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{weatherConsideration} )

SELECT seqAiRouteStop.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblAiRouteStop ( AI_ROUTE_STOP_ID, AI_ROUTE_ID, AI_ROUTE_DAY, AI_ROUTE_STOP_ORDER, AI_ROUTE_LAT, AI_ROUTE_LONG, AI_ROUTE_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_CODE, DURATION_IN_MINUTES, TRANSPORTATION_MODE, WALKING_DISTANCE_KM, WALKING_STEPS_COUNT, RESTAURANT_CATEGORY ) VALUES ( #{aiRouteStopId}, #{aiRouteId}, #{aiRouteDay, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{aiRouteStopOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{aiRouteLat, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiRouteLong, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{aiRouteDescription, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{activityCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{durationInMinutes, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{transportationMode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{walkingDistanceKm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{walkingStepsCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{restaurantCategory, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tblAiRouteStop WHERE AI_ROUTE_ID = #{aiRouteId} ORDER BY AI_ROUTE_DAY, AI_ROUTE_STOP_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tblHealthCareLog ( healthcare_id, user_id, ai_route_stop_id, healthcare_date, healthcare_distance_km, healthcare_steps_count, healthcare_calories_burned ) VALUES ( seqHealthCareLog.nextval, #{userId}, #{aiRouteStopId}, TO_DATE(#{healthcareDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{healthcareDistanceKm}, #{healthcareStepsCount}, #{healthcareCaloriesBurned} )
